scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Monday’s enriched-dough make-up usable by having the required institute-mother levain culture available early enough for the overnight build.
Emerging Need: The culture aliquot is absent, but it matters only after the make-up resolves into a learner-mixed naturally leavened formula rather than a demo or yeast-sponge format.
Decision Context: Stored records and protocol notes identify the missing aliquot hold, conditional eligibility, safe disclosures, verified route, and build-time cutoff; live notices resolve schedule, channel, and formula assignment.
Consequence: Timely prerequisite handling preserves a viable levain-build path, while the sealed pickup batch leaves no culture posting early enough for precheck.
